# value_at golden -- heuristic_agent.rs and ValueModel.java.
# case <name>
# player <home|away> <nr> <x> <y> <st>
# ball <x> <y> <loose>   (absent when there is no ball)
# mover <name> <home> <carrier> <ma> <ag> <str> <sure_hands> <side_step> <catch> <d_now> <turns_left> <unact f32 bits>
# value <f32 bits per cell, 8 hex chars each>
# rule <one char per cell: T=Touchdown A=Advance P=Pickup S=Support ?=other>
